details: The U.S. Senate has postponed a vote on the CLARITY Act, a crucial bill aimed at establishing a clear regulatory framework for the crypto market. The delay pushes the legislation past the August recess, likely into September, leaving significant regulatory uncertainty for digital assets. JPMorgan analysts previously highlighted this legislation as a potential catalyst, and the current delay is seen as a headwind for the broader crypto market, potentially impacting institutional investment and tokenization initiatives. The bill seeks to divide oversight responsibilities between the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
title: US Senate Delays CLARITY Act Vote Until September Recess

details: The U.S. stock market has recently experienced a technology-led rally, pushing indices to record peaks. However, this momentum faces a crucial test next week with the release of fresh inflation data, specifically the U.S. consumer price index (CPI) report. A higher-than-expected inflation figure could strengthen the case for the Federal Reserve to consider raising interest rates, potentially leading to a "risk-off" sentiment in broader financial markets. A Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis president recently advocated for an earlier interest rate hike to curb inflation, underscoring ongoing hawkish sentiment among some policymakers despite a recent unexpected contraction in July's jobs report.
title: Upcoming US Inflation Data to Test Stock Rally and Fed Rate Views
